rows.text: The release dated 'Saturday, 09 August 2014' is headed 'Presidential speech by Shri Amit Shah at BJP National Council Meeting at New Delhi' and 'PRESIDENTIAL ADDRESS OF SHRI AMIT SHAH', and in it he says 'As President of the party, I am grateful to the people of this country'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the address he expresses gratitude 'to this august house and the top BJP leadership for posing faith in me', speaks of 'my election as the BJP's National President', and says 'it is in this backdrop that I am taking the reins of leadership of the party'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the same address he says 'Rajnath Singh ji, during his tenure as National President, played a pivotal role in returning the BJP to power'.
